When we study the autotrophic-heterotrophic spatial feedback we always consider the size of the ecosystems to be the same. In my past experiment I show that the size of the ecosystems matter. However, we only showed that the relative size of ecosystems had an effect. Here, I ran an experiment in which I show that the absolute size of ecosystems matters as well. To do so, I run an experiment.
